ServicesPage.metaDescription: Smart roadside assistance, a 24/7 operations desk, replacement cars, periodic maintenance and emergency response: how each Novera Mobility service works and which products include it.
ServicesPage.title: Our Services
ServicesPage.intro: Beyond renting a car: we stand by you on the road, across the fleet and at your desk.

items.title: Smart Roadside Assistance & Towing
items.summary: In a crash or breakdown, the partner tow truck nearest to your GPS coordinates is directed to you live.
points: Ready in a crash or breakdown
steps: Call us from the app or by phone
Share your location and we direct the nearest tow truck
The truck is on its way: follow it live until it arrives

items.title: 24/7 Live Operations Desk
items.summary: Crisis management that drivers can reach instantly through the app or by phone.
points: Reach us by app or phone
steps: Reach us from the app or by phone
The operations desk takes the situation and opens the case
We follow you personally until it is solved

items.title: Uninterrupted Replacement Car
items.summary: When a breakdown lasts more than 24 hours, an equivalent replacement car comes to your door so work does not stop.
steps: When a breakdown passes 24 hours, a replacement is planned automatically
An equivalent car is prepared for your address
Take the car and keep working

items.title: Periodic Maintenance & Tyre Hotel
items.summary: Summer and winter tyre changes, inspection tracking and valet service from your address.
steps: We remind you when a service or tyre change is due
A valet collects the car from your address
It comes back serviced and clean

items.title: Novera SOS & Emergency Response
items.summary: With one tap, every emergency response unit is at your live location.
steps: Tap the SOS button in the app once
Your live location reaches the emergency units
Teams are directed and the desk calls you
